headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:

▸ cjpais /Handy：A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.

▸ Donchitos /Claude-Code-Game-Studios：Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coor
